decisions.reason: As a large growing marking-systems manufacturer with strong in-house R&D, we would keep this high-resolution piezo inkjet printer because it is close to our core offer and supports demand for reliable, contact-free industrial coding and traceability.

We would keep this backside numbering software module because it strengthens our digital inline printing portfolio, fits our strategic move toward digitalization and serialization, and leverages our installed hardware base with relatively low additional risk.

We would keep this inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces because it expands application coverage for existing customers, uses our ink and coding know-how, and matches our one-stop customized solution strategy.
